description: See an automation's texts exactly as they would go out, without sending: works on drafts. Pass sample event properties (e.g. {"amount": 9.99}) and optionally `to` for a contact's merge fields. Returns each send_sms step's final text (brand and opt-out wording added as we would), segments, encoding, estimated cost, merge fields that would come out empty, and, for an optimal-user-time step with `to`, next_send: when it would go for that person and why.

properties.description: Sample event properties for merge fields, e.g. {"plan": "pro"}

to.description: E.164. Fills contact merge fields and shows when an optimal-user-time text would go for this person
